quiz.0.question: Among the four chemical pillars of wine ageing, which is the most critical 'first line of defence'?
quiz.0.options.1: Acidity (tartaric acid) — protecting against microbial spoilage and oxidation
quiz.0.explanation: Natural acidity is wine's primary preservative — it lowers pH to inhibit microbial growth and slows oxidation. Without sufficient acidity, even high tannin or alcohol cannot guarantee long-term preservation.
quiz.1.question: If a Barolo is stored at 20°C room temperature for 20 years, this is equivalent to ageing how long in a professional cellar (14°C)?
quiz.1.options.1: Approximately 10–12 years (wine ages roughly twice as fast at 20°C vs 14°C)
quiz.1.explanation: Biochemical reaction rates roughly double with every 10°C temperature rise (Arrhenius equation). Storing at 20°C instead of 14°C means the wine ages nearly twice as quickly — effectively shortening the ageing window by half.
quiz.2.question: Which combination of characteristics represents a wine at its 'peak maturity' (10–20 years)?
quiz.2.options.0: Bright ruby with intense primary fruit
quiz.2.options.1: Garnet colour with orange rim + dried fruit + earthy/forest-floor notes + silky tannins
quiz.2.options.2: Very pale brown with vinegar-like aromas
quiz.2.options.3: Deep inky purple with jammy blackberry
quiz.2.explanation: A wine at its peak shows: garnet colour with developing orange rim (oxidation at the edge), evolving tertiary aromas (dried fruit, earth, leather), and tannins softened to a silky, integrated texture.
quiz.3.question: When using an ageing potential checklist, which wine would score highest?
quiz.3.options.0: A light Barbera d'Asti with 12.5% alcohol
quiz.3.options.1: A Barolo Riserva from a great vintage with high acidity, high tannins and high concentration
quiz.3.options.3: A Prosecco from the current vintage
quiz.3.explanation: An ageing potential checklist considers: acidity, tannin, concentration/extract, structure balance, provenance and vintage. A Barolo Riserva from a top vintage scores highest on all criteria.
